verdict.rationale: Docs confirm hosted KYC/KYB verification flows required for onboarding all user types, pre-built UI components (Elements) for bank account/Recipient registration, PCI-compliant card vaulting, and multi-language SDKs to drive the API without building forms. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a hosted terms-of-service/acceptance component, and independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs.
